"""Build the batching 1-vs-16 report (modeled ms) for seeds 0-9."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from run import experiment

SEEDS = range(10)


def build():
    runs = []
    for seed in SEEDS:
        for workload, sizes in experiment(seed).items():
            for size, s in sizes.items():
                runs.append({"seed": seed, "workload": workload, "batch_size": int(size), **s})
    return {"runs": runs, "conclusion": conclude(runs)}


def mean_of(runs, workload, size, key="mean_ms"):
    v = [r[key] for r in runs if r["workload"] == workload and r["batch_size"] == size]
    return sum(v) / len(v)


def conclude(runs):
    parts = []
    for w in ("sparse", "burst"):
        n = [r["count"] for r in runs if r["workload"] == w][0]
        m1, m16 = mean_of(runs, w, 1), mean_of(runs, w, 16)
        p1, p16 = mean_of(runs, w, 1, "p95_ms"), mean_of(runs, w, 16, "p95_ms")
        wins = sum(
            a["mean_ms"] > b["mean_ms"]
            for a in runs for b in runs
            if a["workload"] == b["workload"] == w and a["seed"] == b["seed"]
            and a["batch_size"] == 1 and b["batch_size"] == 16)
        verdict = "lowers" if m16 < m1 else "raises"
        parts.append(
            f"{w} ({n} requests/seed, 10 seeds): batch 16 {verdict} mean latency "
            f"({m1:.1f} -> {m16:.1f} ms; mean p95 {p1:.1f} -> {p16:.1f} ms); "
            f"lower in {wins}/10 seeds.")
    return (" ".join(parts) + " Batching 16 does not reduce latency in both workloads: "
            "it helps the burst trace (queueing behind size-1 service) and hurts the sparse "
            "trace (each request waits the 20 ms batch deadline). Modeled ms, not wall-clock.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "build/batching.json")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(build(), indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(out)
EOF
